output.reason: The evidence supports that (1) the REs must formulate a Board-approved policy on penal charges (or similar charges), (2) the quantum of penal charges must be reasonable and commensurate with non-compliance and not discriminatory, and (3) penal charges must not be levied in the form of penal interest added to the rate of interest. However, the evidence does not state that penal charges must be “disclosed,” and it does not address any “credit-card late fee amount,” so that portion of the claim is not fully supported.
